about: The quiz set of images/east-asia-quiz: the single source of truth for codes, names, capitals and marker points.
Set: the UN geoscheme's Eastern Asia and South-eastern Asia, plus Palau; Taiwan is its own country, Hong Kong and Macao are part of China (tools/README.md).
id: Natural Earth ADM0_A3 code (also the element id in site/map.svg).
name, capital: English short forms per the EU Interinstitutional Style Guide (Myanmar for its Myanmar/Burma), plain ASCII; Taiwan by its common English names; choices in tools/README.md.
marker: [lon, lat] for countries too small to tap at the full view: a ring is drawn there with a generous hit area.
Marker points are curated (roughly the middle of the country's main land), not taken from the polygons.
Everything else in the map window (India, Bangladesh, Russia incl. the Kuril islands, Kazakhstan, Papua New Guinea, Australia, Guam, ...) is context land.
